notes.title: Announcement of Release Date and Recruitment of Early Access Applicants
notes.notes:
Regarding the Release Date of Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-

We are pleased to announce that the release date has been set for September 10, 2025.

In line with this, we are now recruiting streamers who would like to take part in early access streaming.
[hr][/hr]
● Eligibility

Able to livestream on YouTube before September 10

Have 50 or more channel subscribers

Have at least 2 past livestreams

Willing to keep the archive available (in principle)
[hr][/hr]
● How to Apply
Please send us a DM via the official Imagawa Soft X account:


https://x.com/ImagawaSoft


[hr][/hr]
We are also releasing a thumbnail template (just add a character image and it’s ready to use) as well as materials to help you create your own.
These include game and character assets you can freely arrange to create professional-looking visuals.

Streamer Resource Folder:


https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ccLrsLgiZQFogmKebHiLb0LafoNttZmm?usp=sharing


[hr][/hr]
Notes:

Example usage included

Applications may be declined based on certain criteria

Limited availability
[hr][/hr]
If you want, I can also make a shorter, social-media-friendly version that fits platform character limits while keeping the main points. Would you like me to prepare that next?

notes.title: Announcement: Demo Release
notes.notes:
April 12, 2025

We have released the demo version of "Manalia Notes -A memory of innocence-".

In this demo, you can play Stage 1 (Standard difficulty only) with all three available characters.
We hope you enjoy experiencing the game firsthand!

■ URL
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3652340/Manalia_Notes_A_memory_of_innocence_Demo/
